answer:
Here is what I would take to your check-up, most urgent first. I can't examine you, so these are things to ask about, not diagnoses. The records only show what was filed, so a test done somewhere else may not appear here.

1. Hydrochlorothiazide and your sodium. The hospital stopped hydrochlorothiazide on March 5 because your sodium had dropped to 123. But your pharmacy record still shows it as active with refills, and the list you gave at your eye visit on May 14 includes it as a daily pill. Your sodium was still low on June 15 (134), and there is no sodium test since. Please confirm whether you are still taking it, and ask for a sodium recheck.

2. Lung nodule. The October 18, 2025 CT of your abdomen found a 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lung and recommended a chest CT in 6 to 12 months. The 12-month mark was about October 18, 2026. No chest CT is in your records, so it is due now.

3. Thyroid. Your TSH was high on March 3 (7.9), and the discharge asked for a repeat TSH and free T4 in 6 to 8 weeks. Nothing after March is recorded. Your free T4 was normal.

4. Cholesterol and a statin. In September 2025 your LDL was 142 and HDL was 48. You have type 2 diabetes, but no cholesterol medicine and no lipid test since then appear in your records. Ask whether you should be on a statin.

5. Diabetes checks. Your A1c has come down (6.9, then 6.7, then 6.6), and your May eye exam showed no diabetic retinopathy. Missing is a urine albumin-to-creatinine test, which is usually done yearly with diabetes.

6. Urine after the kidney stone. The October urine test showed large blood. I see no repeat urine test, no record that the stone passed, and no urology follow-up.

7. Vaccines. Your Shingrix first dose was November 8, 2025, but the second dose (due 2 to 6 months later) is not recorded. No flu shot for this season and no tetanus booster are recorded.

8. Medicine list. Amlodipine, losartan, metformin and Claritin each appear several times from different sources. Ask for one reconciled list so you do not take a medicine twice.

9. Colonoscopy, not overdue. Your April 2019 colonoscopy was normal, and the next is due around 2029.
short: Please check whether I am still taking hydrochlorothiazide, since sodium was low in June (134). Also ask about a chest CT now overdue for a 7 mm lung nodule, a missed thyroid recheck, a statin given my diabetes and LDL of 142, a missing urine albumin test, and a second Shingrix dose.

knowledge.says: Thiazide diuretics can cause low sodium, especially in older adults. After such an episode the drug is stopped and sodium is rechecked. A sodium still low in June, with the drug possibly still in use, needs a check of current use and a repeat test.
